Today we explore When there is an intersection on the extension line of two non-intersecting segments and products of distances from the intersection to two endpoints of each segments are equal, end points of two segments are on a circle. through a step-by-step visual proof. It is Polya's first auxiliary line and step-by-step division that connects the given conditions into one symmetry, congruence, and similarity structure. A relationship that was not visible through the original shape alone is divided into two comparable shapes by this single green auxiliary line!

narrations.en: Step 5, pages 9 to 10. Check the target shape to the right of the top arrow. This means that, given the starting assumption on the left, the final conclusion that the core theorem and relational expression on the right of the arrow, 'If there is no intersection of two line segments and the product of the distance from the end point of each line segment to the intersection point at the intersection of the extension lines of the two line segments is the same, then the end point of the line segment is on a circle' always holds, is meant to show why the final conclusion is always held. pages.step_title: Step 7 · 핵심 증명 논리 완성 및 오개념 점검
pages.step_question_ko: ⚠️ [오개념 점검 질문] 증명할 결론을 미리 가정으로 끌어다 쓰는 순환논리 실수를 피하려면 무엇을 확인해야 할까요?
pages.step_question_en: ⚠️ [Misconception check question] What should I check to avoid the mistake of circular logic, which is drawing conclusions in advance into assumptions?

narrations.en: Step 12: Final Step — The visual proof is complete! Starting from the basic definition and starting condition (assumption) given in the starting condition, 'If the product of the distance from the end point of each line segment to the intersection point is the same at the intersection of the extension lines of the two line segments when there is no intersection point of the two line segments, the end point of the line segment is on a circle,' through Polya's first auxiliary line and step-by-step division that connects the given conditions into one symmetry, congruence, and similarity structure, 'At the intersection of the extension lines of the two line segments when there is no intersection point of the two line segments,' It was clearly confirmed that the final conclusion that the key theorem and relational expression 'If the product of the distance from the end point of each line segment to the intersection is the same, the end point of the line segment is on a circle' is always held is true.
